content: Upstream requirements: SRS_Os_11005 Check access to peripheral registers The Operating System shall only execute access to peripheral registers via APIs Read PeripheralX, WritePeripheralX and ModifyPeripheralX if : • parameter Address is in range of OsPeripheralAreaStartAddress and Os- PeripheralAreaEndAddress • parameter Area is valid • the caller is configured to have sufficient rights ( OsPeripheralAreaAc- cessingApplication ).
